title: Community Flows: the 1.5 authoring shape and the 1.6 package format
description: UMBRELLA created by the consolidation sweep, 2026-08-14. Members: MPI-531 (package-ready Flows for 1.5 - a 1.5 RELEASE BLOCKER) and MPI-532 (community flow packages, targets 1.6). One format decided twice: uiComponent names a JS component a third party can never have, so every Flow authored with a new component in 1.5 is a Flow that must be ported in 1.6. MPI-531 item 1 (FlowStepField slider/number/text) is also MPI-552s single blocker, which makes it the highest-priority item on the Flow track. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md.
